summary: Completed backend and frontend validation for Event Reports with auth/RBAC, org scoping, summary accuracy, CSV/XLSX integrity, metadata safety, edge-case IDs/formats, empty and large-event handling, and focused regression smoke.
action_items: Optional hardening: add explicit backend assertions/tests for multi-membership organization switch + in-flight reports summary abort behavior (frontend hook already uses AbortController).
critical_code_review_comments: Non-reports legacy risk observed: /api/events getAllEvents() currently queries {} without organization scope; reports routes are correctly scoped, but global events endpoint may leak cross-organization event rows.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (focused Event Reports UI flow validated in final run)

seed_data_creation: Temporary API and DB fixtures were created by tests and cleaned by teardown. UI run created TEST_UI_* events in-app for edge checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Final playwright run passed: direct /#reports no /api/certificates or /api/analytics prefetch; empty-event generation disabled; XLSX/CSV generation headers correct; long-title overflow absent on desktop and mobile. Bulk email flow is MOCKED behavior (send-email sets sent_email=true; no external provider verification done).
rca of the issue: No blocking implementation bug found in Event Reports. Earlier frontend test interruptions were caused by insufficient wait logic during option loading and by brittle duplicate-suppression timing assertions in the test script; final stabilized script passed.
